title: Design-system registry
description: Every shared component's persistent id, atomic level and source file. The id is stamped on the component's DOM as data-ds and on its Pencil node as metadata.id.

id.description: Persistent kebab-case id. Never rename or reuse one; move a removed id to `retired`.

name.description: PascalCase story leaf, as Storybook titles it (Design System/<Level>/<name>).

stories.description: Extra story leaves that document this component and share its level.

selector.description: Only for components whose DOM cannot carry data-ds (third-party roots): the CSS selector that finds them instead.

export.description: The export that renders the data-ds element, when it isn't `name` (the popup for overlays, the trigger for Select). Its props are the component's variant axes.

exempt.description: Component files with nothing to mirror (providers, effects).

retired.description: Ids that once existed. They are never reused.
